name: DR Lyd
author: Martin
description: Play DR's radio channels (P1-P8, regional P4/P5, LYD ekstra) straight from the bar.

barWidget.description: Play DR's radio channels straight from the bar

schema.label: Default channel (slug)
schema.description: Channel slug from dr.dk/lyd/<slug>, e.g. p1, p2, p3, p6beat, p8jazz. Used for middle-click until a channel has been played.

schema.label: Audio quality
schema.description: Preferred ICY MP3 bitrate. Falls back to HLS if ICY is unavailable.

schema.label: Log listening history
schema.description: Save the tracks you listen to in ~/.local/state/omarchy/dr-lyd/history.sqlite (shown under History in the panel).

schema.label: Keep history (days)
schema.description: Delete logged tracks older than this many days when the shell starts. 0 keeps everything.

schema.label: Refresh fills history from
schema.description: How far back the refresh button fills in the history: the start of the programme you first listened to today (e.g. all of Morgenbeatet), the top of that hour, or only from the first track you heard.
